_doc: Reviewed extraction of Table III-B, 'Area irrigated by different sources', from the DES Season and Crop Report. Every figure here was read from the report PDF by a person and is re-verified against the PDF before this file changes; scripts/atlas-irrigation-tn-district.ts validates it and writes the served artifact. Net area by source is what the report prints per column group; supplementary wells water land already counted under another source and are NOT additive to the net total.

source.table: III-B, Area irrigated by different sources, pages 125-131

supplementaryWellsNote: The report's supplementary-wells column ('by all other types of wells') records 0 ha net for this district in 2024-25.
notes: The five source components sum exactly to the printed net total of 138856 ha.
Canals 21.9%, open wells 64.9%, tube and bore wells 12.4% of the net irrigated area.
The report prints 141847 ha gross and 2990 ha irrigated more than once; gross minus net is 2991 ha, a rounding artifact in the report itself.
